subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split this broad field report into focused canonical issues and close the umbrella, or keep the umbrella open as the routing tracker?
rationale: The remaining work mixes config recovery policy, provider-history catch-up, cron ergonomics, web-search/tool policy, onboarding UX, resource policy, and update behavior; source inspection cannot choose the desired tracking shape or product defaults.

options.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
options.body: Link fixed slices to landed behavior, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792 canonical for their slices, open only focused follow-ups for current-main gaps, then close this broad tracker.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed or rejected, accepting weaker automation signal because it spans several owners and product decisions.

options.title: Close As Partially Superseded
options.body: Close now with links to narrower open issues and ask reporters to file any remaining slice that still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
recommendation.body: Link fixed slices to landed behavior, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792 canonical for their slices, open only focused follow-ups for current-main gaps, then close this broad tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-line ownership spans the most central config, Discord, onboarding, and cron surfaces, making this the best available routing owner from history evidence.
